data.name: Makramah
data.gender_notes: Makramah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'kr-m', meaning to be generous or kind. Makramah embodies the spirit of giving and compassion. In Islamic tradition, it is considered a noble trait for a person to be makram, or kind and generous. The name Makramah carries the meaning “Generous, Benevolent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Makramah usually hope their child will grow to embody generous, benevolent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the abundant blessings and kindness bestowed by Allah SWT.
data.etymology: Makramah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Generous, Benevolent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Makramah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic societies, the virtue of Makramah is highly valued and constantly encouraged. It is believed that practicing Makramah not only benefits those who receive kindness but also brings blessings and good fortune to the giver. Makramah is often expressed through acts of charity, hospitality, and giving of one's time and resources to others in need.
data.spiritual_significance: Makramah is an essential aspect of Islamic spirituality. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) taught that "The believer's shield on the Day of Resurrection will be his good deeds." (Bukhari and Muslim). By practicing Makramah, individuals can accumulate good deeds that will protect them on the Day of Judgment. Moreover, being kind and compassionate to others is an outward manifestation of inner faith and a sign of one's closeness to Allah. Makramah helps to create harmony and unity in society, fostering a positive and peaceful community.
